jobs.description_md:
# Student, Large Corporates and Institutions DK

København S, DK, 2300

**Job ID: 7570**

Are you interested in corporate banking and financial analysis? Join LC&I Denmark and support management and client teams working with some of the largest and most sophisticated corporate and institutional customers in the Danish market. We are looking for a student to be part of LC&I Denmark covering some of the largest and most sophisticated corporate and institutional customers in the Danish market. You will have many great opportunities to learn and grow as you advance your career with us.

**About this opportunity**

As the Student in Large Corporates & Institutions you play a valuable role in focusing in creating great customer experiences for corporate and instituional customers through our relationship strategy and in-depth expertise. 

**What you will be doing:**

* Support management with financial reporting, data management and project-related analysis.
* Assist client teams with credit analysis, financial follow-up and capital-related analysis.
* Prepare client presentations and update presentation materials.
* Work with Client Associates to maintain and improve databases.
* You will support Client Associates in optimizing administrative tasks where excellent excel skills will be preferable

The role is based in Copenhagen.

**Who you are**

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the four key values that guide us in being at our best – and that we imaging you share with us. To succeed in this role, you have strong financial analytical skills, good in excel- and data base related projects and have excellent interpersonal skills.

**Your profile and background:**

* You are studying to obtain a Master’s degree in Finance within the next 2-4 years
* You have a high degree of personal drive and you are good in finding new ways of doing things
* You have strong capabilities in Excel, PowerPoint and programming would be an advantage
* You have practical expirenced using AI tools
* You are proactive and have a commercial attitude with a positive mindset
* You are fluent in Danish and English

**What we offer**

**People** come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

**A culture** that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

**Hybrid working model** – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

**Diversity and inclusion** are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, let’s get in touch!

**Next steps**

Submit your application no later than 04/12/2026. For more information about the position, you are welcome to contact Tina Volsgaard +45 61222911, tina.volsgaard@nordea.com or Charlotte Buhl +45 2527 9823, charlotte.buhl@nordea.com.

**The recruitment process consists of the following steps:**

* Preliminary CV selection
* Interview with the hiring leader
* Background and referencecheck

**We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.**

**We build relationships.** We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

**We learn and develop.** We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

**We lead change.** We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

**We are Nordea.** We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

jobs.description_md:
# Studentermedarbejder i Business Banking DK

København S, DK, 2300

**Job ID: 7222**

Vi søger en selvstændig og engageret studentermedarbejder, som kan blive en del af vores team i Business Banking DK Office, hvor du vil være med til at levere support til vores lederteam, koordinere og eksekvere på interne og eksterne arrangementer og deltage i initiativer for at styrke vores forretning.   

**Om vores team**

Velkommen til Business Banking Danmark, hvor vi er ansvarlige for små og mellemstore virksomheder. Vores kunder bliver serviceret af vores dygtige rådgivere, understøttet af kompetente kreditspecialister, produktspecialister, supportfunktioner over hele landet samt Nordea Business Center (NBC).

BB DK Office er tæt på både beslutningerne og eksekveringen i Business Banking Danmark. Vi understøtter ledelsen med centrale ledelsesprocesser og skaber samtidig struktur, fremdrift og eksekvering på strategiske og tværgående agendaer.

**Det skal du arbejde med**

* Supportere ledelsen og Business Banking DK med administrative opgaver og opbygge god forståelse for interne systemer (fx fakturahåndtering og HR-systemer)
* Planlægge, koordinere og eksekvere på både interne og eksterne begivenheder og arrangementer
* Løse opgaver og deltage i initiativer af forskellig karakter, ofte i samarbejde med stakeholdere.
* Sikre overblik og struktur i opfølgning

**Hvem du er**

**For at blive succesfuld i rollen forventer vi, at du;**

* Er serviceminded, nysgerrig og proaktiv
* Er struktureret, detaljeorienteret og analytisk
* Er god til at samarbejde med stakeholders i flere forskellige dele af organisationen
* Stort kendskab til MS Office-værktøjer og er tryg ved at tage nye teknologier og applikationer i brug
* Er stærk i skriftlig og mundtlig kommunikation og flydende på dansk og engelsk
* Studerer på universitetet, gerne på 2. eller 3 studieår

Rollen er med base på vores hovedkontor (Metro) i København) og er på 15 timer om ugen.

**Det tilbyder vi**

Vores nye kolleger kommer til os, når de ønsker at udvikle sig. For nogle er det næste skridt på vejen i deres karriere. For andre er det at sætte nye mål inden for deres ekspertiseområde – med andre ord, hos os kommer du altid videre.

En kultur, der fremmer præstation og vækst i en af de største nordiske banker, som tilbyder forskellige muligheder for at udfolde sig, udvikle sig og lære af dygtige kolleger med forskellig baggrund i et levende arbejdsmiljø.

Hybrid arbejdsmodel – vi tror på værdien af at føre mennesker sammen, og samtidig vælger vi friheden ved at være fleksible.

Mangfoldighed og inklusion er en naturlig del af vores daglige arbejde. Vi ved, at en inkluderende arbejdsplads er bæredygtig. Vi tror oprigtigt på, at vores forskellige baggrunde, erfaringer, egenskaber og personligheder gør os stærkere sammen. Hver dag stræber vi efter at finde nye måder at forbedre mangfoldighed og inklusion i vores netværk på, f.eks. har vi underskrevet mangfoldighedschartre under EU-Kommissionen i de lande, hvor vi driver virksomhed, for at understrege vores villighed til at engagere os med andre for at fortsætte med at lære og forbedre os.

Hvis dette lyder som dig, så kontakt os!

**De næste trin**

Lyder dette som dig, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt og senest den 23/11/2026. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Head of BB DK Office, Caroline Gammelgaard, på caroline.gammelgaard@nordea.com. Der vil blive afholdt samtaler løbende.

**Rekrutteringsprocessen består af følgende trin:**

* Foreløbig udvælgelse af CV
* Interview med den ansættende leder
* Baggrunds- og referencertjek

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

Vi opbygger relationer. Vi sætter et personligt præg på alt, hvad vi gør – når vi rådgiver vores kunder, samarbejder med kolleger og møder vores potentielle kandidater.

Vi lærer og udvikler os. Vi sætter en ære i at være eksperter og tænke fremad. Vi anvender vores ekspertise til at imødekomme vores kunders behov, fra de enkleste til de mest komplekse. Vi har en tankegang om vækst i vores arbejde, der gør det muligt for os at fokusere bredere i vores daglige udfordringer.

Vi står i spidsen for forandring. Vi er ansvarlige og bevidste om virkningen af vores beslutninger, både for vores kunder og for vores lokale og globale samfund. Vi er opmærksomme på vores ansvar over for nuværende og fremtidige generationer og har gjort bæredygtighed til en integreret del af vores forretningsstrategi.

Vi er Nordea. Vi har 200 års historie med at støtte og få de nordiske økonomier til at vokse, og vores værdier er dybt forankret i disse åbne, progressive og samarbejdsvillige samfund. Som en af de største arbejdsgivere i Norden, Polen og Estland har du gode muligheder for at udfolde dig, udvikle dig og komme videre med os.

# Udfordrende og fleksibelt studiejob i Nordens største bank - Odense

Odense C, DK, 5000

**Job ID: 7279**

Har du et højt ambitionsniveau, er du energisk, og brænder du for at skabe de bedste kundeoplevelser i selskab med fantastiske kollegaer? Lige nu ansætter vi studerende fra videregående uddannelser (du har minimum 1,5 år tilbage af studiet uden praktik eller udlandsophold), som søger et fedt studiejob med masser af udfordringer og en stejl læringskurve.

Vi tilbyder et spændende job med et mangfoldigt arbejdsmiljø, fleksible vagter og en god løn. Vi leder efter nye kollegaer til Nordeas kundeservice i Odense.

Som ansat arbejder du i gennemsnit 12 timer om ugen. Du vil begynde i jobbet 15. februar 2027, og de første 14 dage skal du kunne deltage i oplæringen på fuld tid (37 timer/ugen), og de efterfølgende 14 dage skal du kunne arbejde mindst 20 timer/ugen i hverdagene.

Under oplæringen vil du lære alt det, du skal vide for at kunne hjælpe vores kunder og give dem verdensklasse oplevelser. Derfor er det ikke vigtigt, hvad du studerer, så længe du har passion for og lyst til at tale med vores kunder.  

**Om jobbet**

”Mit kort er blevet stjålet!”. ”Hvordan kommer jeg i gang med at bruge jeres Mobilbank?”. Vores kunder kan have alverdens spørgsmål, og din opgave består i at servicere og skabe ekstraordinære oplevelser i hver eneste kundekontakt. Som kollega bliver du en del af vores stærke kundeservice, som vi kalder Nordea 24/7. Du bliver en del af nordens største bank, hvor der på sigt også kan være mulighed for at fortsætte din karriere.  

Størstedelen af arbejdsdagen går med at tale i telefon med vores kunder og løse deres forskellige ærinder. Du ringer derfor ikke aktivt ud til kunderne, men tager i stedet imod dem på telefon, når de henvender sig til os. Kunderne skal kunne få fat i os døgnet rundt, alle ugens dage – så vores hverdage er tempofyldte og varierende. Du kommer til at arbejde i et socialt arbejdsmiljø med andre studerende og fuldtidsansatte i alle aldre.

Du får energi af at kommunikere med mennesker. jobs.title: Student employee for Forward Trading & New Markets Technology
jobs.location: Aarhus, Denmark Kalkværksvej Aarhus Denmark Aarhus, Denmark Kalkværksvej Aarhus Denmark Aarhus
jobs.description_md:
## Quote

From day one, you'll help build software used by traders and analysts making decisions in European energy markets. Your solutions won't sit in a backlog or a sandbox. They will support real trading activities and new market opportunities.

## Here’s what the job entails

In the role as Junior Software Engineer, you will help develop and maintain software solutions that support energy trading in the forward market in close collaboration with software engineers, traders, and business stakeholders. You will participate in code reviews, agile development activities and continuous improvement initiatives, while developing your technical skills and bringing fresh ideas to the team.

More specifically, your responsibilities include:

* helping build tools that solve real problems for traders and analysts
* working on feature development alongside experienced software engineers
* gaining hands-on experience with Azure, CI/CD, APIs, databases, and professional software development practices
* participating in agile ceremonies, code reviews, and team knowledge sharing

## Meet your team

We are a cross-functional product team supporting the Forward Trading business area across both software engineering and data engineering. Our primary focus is to build and operate software products that support day-to-day trading activities. We provide traders and analysts with access to market data, analytics and insights, and we enable trading capabilities and support emerging market opportunities. We also automate business processes to improve efficiency and reliability and deliver scalable and maintainable solutions in close collaboration with business stakeholders.

We are a team of nine tech specialists with various backgrounds and interests. Being cross-functional means that you will get exposure to both software engineering and data engineering, giving you the opportunity to explore different technologies and develop your skills across disciplines. We are a social team with a special love for funny memes and a competitive edge. We always seek to do our best and help each other out.

## But enough about us… over to you!

As you will be working across both software and data engineering, we imagine that you are curious about technology and motivated to learn and develop your skills in a hands-on environment. You enjoy solving problems, exploring new technologies, and turning ideas into practical solutions. We also picture you as a team-oriented person who enjoys collaborating across disciplines while being comfortable taking responsibility for your own tasks. With a positive and proactive mindset, you are ready to contribute where needed in a dynamic environment.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

* are studying Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical field
* have a keen interest in software development, AI, programming, data and emerging technologies such as agentic engineering
* have experience programming in Python and/or C#
* have some experience with SQL server, Databricks and streaming technologies like Pulsar or Kafka
* can work approx. 20 hours per week

Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role.

## We’ll take good care of you

At Danske Commodities, we take great care of our people. Joining us means you’ll get a lot of great perks – including social events, cultural experiences, tasty food and benefits to better your health, your life and your future.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

**Shape your development** tailored growth plans, 100+ DC University courses & Harvard Learning access

**100+ yearly events** from office parties to DC Sports events, CS:GO team, student network & more

**Global career paths** as part of our parent company, Equinor’s 20,000-strong international network

**Flexible work life**to fit with your studies

**Unlimited paid child’s sick days**because family comes first

**Free tickets & discounts**culture, family fun, hotels, restaurants & more

**Organic meals** light breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner & take-away

**Barista café**high-quality coffee, always on us

**On-site wellness**state-of-the-art gym, physio, chiro and massage therapy

**HQ in the heart of Aarhus**with stunning views, inspiring architecture and close to public transport

…. and much more

**Your role**

As part of the Digital & E-commerce team, you will support the daily operations of our online business and help ensure a smooth and consistent customer experience.Key responsibilities include:

* Supporting the day-to-day running of our e-commerce platforms

**What are we looking for?**

We are preferably looking for someone who:

* Have a strong proficiency in Microsoft Office
* Have high attention to detail, especially when working with data and content
* Is structured and organised, with the ability to manage multiple tasks

* Is fluent in English, both written and spoken
